title: Website Maintenance Cost & Packages (2026 Price Guide)

facts.fact: Website maintenance costs typically range from $50 to $500 per month for most small business websites, according to the page's TL;DR.
facts.quote: Website maintenance costs typically range from $50 to $500 per month for most small business websites, while larger websites and ecommerce stores may pay $500 to $5,000 or more.

facts.fact: Larger websites and ecommerce stores may pay $500 to $5,000 or more per month for maintenance, per the page's TL;DR.
facts.quote: while larger websites and ecommerce stores may pay $500 to $5,000 or more.

facts.fact: The page's planning range for a personal blog or portfolio is $5 to $75 per month, including hosting, domain, and light updates.
facts.quote: | Personal blog or portfolio | $5 to $75 | $60 to $900 | Hosting, domain, light updates |

facts.fact: The page's planning range for a small business site is $50 to $500 per month, or $600 to $6,000 per year.
facts.unit: USD per month / USD per year
facts.quote: | Small business site | $50 to $500 | $600 to $6,000 | Updates, backups, security, small edits |

facts.fact: The page's planning range for a mid-size business site is $200 to $1,500 per month, or $2,400 to $18,000 per year.
facts.unit: USD per month / USD per year
facts.quote: | Mid-size business site | $200 to $1,500 | $2,400 to $18,000 | More pages, forms, integrations, speed work |

facts.fact: The page's planning range for an ecommerce store is $250 to $2,000+ per month, or $3,000 to $24,000+ per year.
facts.unit: USD per month / USD per year
facts.quote: | Ecommerce store | $250 to $2,000+ | $3,000 to $24,000+ | Payments, inventory, security, peak traffic |

facts.fact: The page's planning range for an enterprise or custom build is $1,000 to $5,000+ per month, or $12,000 to $60,000+ per year.
facts.unit: USD per month / USD per year
facts.quote: | Enterprise or custom build | $1,000 to $5,000+ | $12,000 to $60,000+ | Custom code, compliance, dedicated support |

facts.fact: The page states a professionally managed small business site usually costs $100 to $300 per month.
facts.quote: A professionally managed small business site usually costs $100 to $300 a month.

facts.fact: The page states a DIY approach costs $0 to $50 per month in tools, plus 4 to 8 hours of the owner's time each month.
facts.unit: USD per month; hours per month
facts.quote: A DIY approach costs $0 to $50 a month in tools, plus your own time. Plan on 4 to 8 hours of your time each month if you do the work yourself.

facts.fact: The page states ecommerce stores cost two to three times more than an information site of the same size (the author's own estimate, not a sourced figure).
facts.quote: Ecommerce stores cost two to three times more than an information site of the same size.

facts.fact: One agency budget the page reviewed put a small site at about $6,700 per year, of which the maintenance plan was $3,600.
facts.quote: One agency budget we reviewed put a small site at about $6,700 a year once content writing and premium plugins were counted. The maintenance plan itself was $3,600 of that.

facts.fact: The page's typical Basic package costs $50 to $150 per month, includes 0 to 1 support hours, and has a 1 to 2 business day response time for critical issues.
facts.value: $50 to $150; 0 to 1 hour; 1 to 2 business days
facts.unit: USD per month; hours; business days
facts.quote: | Basic | $50 to $150 | 0 to 1 hour | 1 to 2 business days | Brochure sites, portfolios, small blogs |

facts.fact: The page's typical Standard package costs $150 to $500 per month, includes 1 to 3 support hours, and has same-business-day response for critical issues.
facts.value: $150 to $500; 1 to 3 hours; same business day
facts.quote: | Standard | $150 to $500 | 1 to 3 hours | Same business day | Small business lead generation sites |

facts.fact: The page's typical Premium package costs $500 to $5,000+ per month, includes 4 to 20+ support hours, and has a 1 to 4 hour response time for critical issues.
facts.quote: | Premium | $500 to $5,000+ | 4 to 20+ hours | 1 to 4 hours | Ecommerce, SaaS, high-traffic sites |
